message: 親密に親睦会

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hehehe. You're all gonna be so shocked your legs'll give out」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I brought sobagaki!」

name: Synn
message: 「What the heck, it's just soba again after all... And here I was getting my hopes up」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's sobagaki, sobagaki! It's not just plain old soba!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Soba... gaki?」

name: Misa
message: 「Is it not in your guidebook?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That book is seriously lacking Yamato spirit! Sobagaki is kind of like a dumpling made out of buckwheat flour」

name: Synn
message: 「You boil it and eat it dipped in things like wasabi soy sauce」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, I see. I'll jot that down in my guidebook」

name: Ria
message: 「Wasabi...」

name: Misa
message: 「Is something the matter, Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No... it's nothing. More importantly, what about you, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「Um, for me... potatoes, carrots, onions, and chicken」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, completely normal stuff」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What part of that is normal?! Those are obviously super expensive organic pesticide-free veggies and domestically raised free-range chicken!」

name: Synn
message: 「They look the exact same to me, though」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa, can I try a bit of carrot?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, go right ahead」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here, Synn. Just take a little nibble」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I shouldn't have asked this guy. Senpai, try a bite and tell us what you think」

name: Ria
message: 「Mm... Oh, it's fruity」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This is it, right here! It's totally different from what you usually eat!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it is--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That looks delicious. Please let me try some too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eat up, eat up!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek, it's bitter!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tah-haha! Not appreciating this flavor just proves you're still a kid, Lolo-chan. Do you want some too, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'll pass, thank you. Moving right along, please show us what's next」

name: Ria
message: 「What I brought is cheese fondue, wine for cooking, and fish and chips」

name: Synn
message: 「Now that's some elegant-sounding Western food」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't even know what that word means, do you」

name: Ria
message: 「Cheese fondue is delicious when you warm it up and dip bread or veggies in it」

name: Misa
message: 「Piping hot and gooey is definitely the best」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh~」

name: Synn
message: 「Wine is so classy. Truly a choice only you could make, Senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「I've never actually drunk any, though」

name: Synn
message: 「Fish and chips sure looks greasy, though」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It really looks like the kind of food that makes you gain weight~」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Lolotte, hurry up and bring out yours too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes! I brought Mr. Octopus and Mr. Tuna!」

name: Misa
message: 「Mr. Tuna is looking right at me...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Expected nothing less from Milady. Now that's what you call a difference in class.」

name: Ria
message: 「Did you buy it somewhere?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, she actually caught it out at sea. I saw it with my own eyes, so there's no mistake.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right, ehehe\s05」

name: Ria
message: 「Amaaazing」

name: Misa
message: 「Is this a farmed tuna?」

name: Paqy
message: 「From the looks of it, it's wild-caught and frozen.」

name: Ria
message: 「How can he even tell?\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Are we putting all of this into the hotpot...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's a dark hotpot.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. What a waste.」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder what on earth we'll end up making.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I can't wait!」
